name: Concentration
description: Only one concentration spell at a time. Taking damage requires a Constitution saving throw with DC 10 or half the damage taken, whichever is higher.

name: Spell Save DC
description: Spell save DC equals 8 + proficiency bonus + spellcasting ability modifier.

name: Spell Attack Modifier
description: Spell attack modifier equals proficiency bonus + spellcasting ability modifier.

name: Spell Components
description: Spells may require verbal, somatic, and material components. A focus or component pouch can replace material components without listed costs, but not consumed or priced materials.

name: Bonus Action Spell
description: If you cast a spell as a bonus action, the only other spell you can cast that turn is a cantrip with a casting time of one action.

name: Ritual Casting
description: A spell with the ritual tag can be cast as a ritual by a caster with an appropriate feature, adding 10 minutes without spending a slot.

name: Spell Slots
description: Casting a leveled spell normally expends a slot of its level or higher; cantrips do not require slots.

name: Spell Points
description: Optional alternative to spell slots, described in the 2014 Dungeon Master’s Guide.
